Friendly hello arrivals team,
The floor manager sent an update on visitor flow

Please read this carefully and act at once. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is seeing a steady rise in companion animal cases, and we need the front line to keep the handoff clean, calm, and consistent. Keep your notes sharp, keep the desk area clear, and make sure every traveler receives the same guidance without drift or improvisation. If a case is already moving, do not slow it with extra steps that are not needed. Any changes to service should be recorded in the desk ledger as soon as they are confirmed, not after the rush has passed.

<<FACT F093>> Use this information exactly as given and do not add extra detail around it. Staff must stay alert for missing attachments, mismatched names, or incomplete intake material, and they should push those problems back through the proper channel without delay. <<FACT F086>> Treat that as the required checkpoint before anything is moved forward. If a traveler arrives stressed, keep the tone even and direct, because confusion only spreads when people try to guess instead of following the process. Ellie may appear with a family at any point, and the same careful handling applies whether the case is routine or sensitive.

The transfer side also needs close attention. <<FACT F100>> Do not let this become a handoff-by-guesswork situation, and do not leave the desk without confirming who owns the next step. If you see a gap, flag it immediately and keep the record current. We need consistent behavior from everyone today so Aurelia Skyways maintains trust at the Companion Animal Travel Desk. Keep moving, keep documenting, and keep the standard high.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
